id: title:EDsCODE:preserve trino functions in saved view diagnostics

observations.behavior: Adds explicit type resolution and a dedicated printer for HogQL diagnostics.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the diagnostic output path from generic HogQL printing to Trino-specific rendering after resolving types. This could preserve correct column names and function syntax in saved-query dependencies when rendered as diagnostics.

observations.behavior: Uses a new Trino-aware HogQL printer instead of the previous utility that printed directly without prior type resolution.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides clearer, warehouse-aligned diagnostics while retaining compatibility with existing query execution; relevant for users relying on saved queries or warehouse-dependent metadata.

observations.code_quote: assert compiled.hogql == ("SELECT event FROM events LIMIT 1" if include_hogql else None)
observations.behavior: Adds Django-backed compilation assertions alongside manifest-only behavior, including round-trip checks between SQL and HogQL representations.
observations.posthog_connection: Demonstrates bounded correctness: both paths produce consistent results, supporting reliability of warehouse-dependent workflows rather than changing core ingestion or retention.
